## Intent and scope

Explain the behavior being preserved or changed; link the specification and related PRs.

## Verification

- Baseline and exact tested head SHA:
- RED/GREEN evidence for changed behavior:
- Focused commands and results:
- Full managed integration result:
- Security/publication checks:
- Device-only or operational gates not exercised:

## Review and integration

- [ ] Independent agent's formal GitHub review is tied to this head.
- [ ] Findings have follow-up commits and checked thread replies/resolution.
- [ ] Updated against main; conflicts preserve both PRs' intents and are retested.
- [ ] Required checks are green; no owner bypass or invented approval.
- [ ] Deployment uses the merged main SHA; active sessions are protected.
- [ ] After merge, task worktree/branch and disposable artifacts will be removed.
